summary: Comprehensive testing of UBUYBOX OpenClaw orchestration API and frontend visibility enforcement. All 27 backend tests passed. Frontend correctly enforces visibility states (blocked/teaser/preview/full) with proper field masking.
passed_tests: GET /api/orchestration/health returns ok:true without auth
POST /api/orchestration/load-spv returns 401 without auth
POST /api/orchestration/load-spv returns 403 with invalid token
POST /api/orchestration/load-spv returns view model with valid SPV and auth
POST /api/orchestration/load-spv returns 404 for invalid SPV (SPV_999)
POST /api/orchestration/set-disclosure sets blocked/teaser/preview/full levels
POST /api/orchestration/set-disclosure returns 404 for invalid SPV
POST /api/orchestration/set-disclosure returns 422 for invalid disclosure level
GET /api/orchestration/status/{spvId} returns comprehensive status with auth
GET /api/orchestration/status/{spvId} returns exists:false for invalid SPV
POST /api/orchestration/resolve-visibility resolves visibility state correctly
POST /api/orchestration/resolve-visibility returns blocked for invalid SPV
POST /api/orchestration/set-waterfall-permission sets permitted true/false
POST /api/orchestration/set-waterfall-permission returns 404 for invalid SPV
GET /api/spv-visibility returns visibility map without auth (public endpoint)
Visibility state filtering: teaser shows limited data
Visibility state filtering: blocked shows minimal data with message
Dashboard shows deal cards with teaser visibility masking (Price restricted, Capital stack restricted)
Dashboard shows visibility indicators (Teaser View) on deal cards
Capital Stack page shows all 20 deals with proper visibility masking
SPV Registry shows Visibility column with teaser/preview/full/blocked badges
SPV Registry shows Waterfall column with Gated/Visible badges
Waterfalls page shows 'No Waterfalls Available' when all SPVs gated
Waterfalls page shows gated SPV list with visibility states
Deal Detail page shows visibility badge (preview view - some fields restricted)
Deal Detail page masks seller name and net to seller in preview mode
Deal Detail page shows capital stack in preview mode
Deal Detail page hides waterfall section when not permitted
seed_data_creation: None - all data from Google Sheets
context_for_next_testing_agent: All orchestration endpoints tested and working. Frontend visibility enforcement working correctly. Default visibility is 'teaser' for all SPVs (in-memory state resets on backend restart). Waterfall visibility requires: disclosure='full' + fieldsComplete=true + safeToDisplay=true + waterfallPermitted=true. Currently fieldsComplete=false for all SPVs because Google Sheet Status column is empty.

visibility_states.blocked: Shows SPV ID only with blocked message
visibility_states.teaser: Shows location, status, property type. Hides prices, capital stack, seller info
visibility_states.preview: Shows prices, capital stack, units. Hides seller name, address, net to seller
visibility_states.full: Shows all fields except seller identity (intentionally excluded)

notes.waterfall_gating: All SPVs currently gated because fieldsComplete=false (Status column empty in Google Sheet) and waterfallPermitted defaults to false
